staging.baseline: relative symlink to the formal pages directory
staging.candidate_assets: relative symlink to the unchanged formal assets directory
staging.candidate_runtime: independent authored HTML, CSS and JavaScript files

author_layer.counting_rule: UTF-8 decoded characters including newlines in sample-specific runtime source; shared chassis, vendor seedrandom, tests, screenshots and audit files are excluded
author_layer.decision: The formal source is below 10k only because it compresses the governing system into long lines, abbreviated fields and coupled stages. The full candidate deliberately spends characters on semantic state, named algorithm stages and explicit lifecycle ownership. Re-minifying it would defeat the full-sample learning goal.
author_layer.mini_determination: At 21,895 characters this improved full sample would require a separately designed mini if selected as an auxiliary example. The former 9,800-character file is not an acceptable mini because its algorithm and lifecycle are not sufficiently readable. No mini is created during this full-version pass.

frame_contract.conceptual_seed: A deterministic field of 720 moving nodes forms proximity links; injected energy propagates by shortest arrival time while the title exclusion field protects editorial legibility.
frame_contract.governing_rule: Seeded node motion rebuilds a spatial proximity graph every frame; Dijkstra-like repeated relaxation computes signal arrival across weighted links; time-dependent node light and active edges render the propagation.
frame_contract.fallback_rule: When the main Canvas context is unavailable, the same seeded nodes and 3,807 computed edges produce a deterministic three-layer inline SVG rather than a captured image. If the bundled seedrandom dependency alone fails, a compact deterministic PRNG still builds and animates the live graph instead of losing the governing evidence.

changes: Separated semantic document structure, presentation and governing simulation into index.html, theme.css and neural-network.js so an Agent can identify each layer without unpacking embedded long lines.

Named configuration, typed model arrays, graph construction, shortest-arrival propagation, node evolution, lighting, rendering, input and lifecycle stages without changing their arithmetic or execution order.
Centralized listener ownership under one AbortController and made dispose idempotent; pagehide now cancels RAF/resize/listeners and guards the public reset, inject, pointer and step API.
Exposed read-only state/model inspection for equivalence tests while retaining the original public behavior.
Added a deterministic same-model SVG fallback for Canvas unavailability; the primary Canvas path remains pixel-identical.
Added a deterministic dependency fallback so a missing seedrandom asset still produces a seeded 720-node live graph; the bundled-dependency path and its pixels remain unchanged.

model_hashes.evidence: Runtime interception of every seeded typed-array allocation produced identical baseline/candidate byte hashes before rendering.

pixel_evidence.comparison_rule: Baseline and candidate screenshots were captured in the same controlled Chromium session with fixed requestAnimationFrame time, input and viewport; both absolute pixel error and encoded-byte equality were checked.

tests.name: fixed-state primary-path equivalence
tests.evidence: Nine initial, fixed-clock, pointer, injection and reset screenshot pairs have AE=0 and byte-identical PNG output; the logical Canvas remains 1600x900 in both viewports.

tests.name: governing-model equivalence
tests.evidence: All eight 720-element node Float32 arrays, both edge endpoint Int32 arrays, edge-distance values and initial signal-arrival values are byte-identical; both implementations build 3,807 initial links.

tests.name: input and reset equivalence
tests.evidence: Pointer move/down, real touch pointerdown, Enter, Space and repeated R reset reproduced equal baseline/candidate snapshots and pixels; fast reset restored the seeded model.

tests.name: resize and lifecycle
tests.evidence: Live resize preserves the 1600x900 logical scene; pagehide sets ready=false/disposed=true, stops RAF and resize handling, aborts listeners and makes all public mutators inert; reload restores one clean Canvas instance.

tests.name: deterministic fallback
tests.evidence: Forced loss of the primary Canvas context reports fallback=true and renders one inline SVG with three paths from the same 720 nodes and 3,807 edges. Two independent runs were pixel-identical with zero page errors. Forced loss of seedrandom now retains a deterministic live 720-node graph in two independent runs.

tests.name: runtime and source checks
tests.evidence: JavaScript syntax passes node --check; all local requests succeed, no page/console errors or overflow were observed, and both relative staging symlinks resolve.

rejected_changes.change: Return to one-letter arrays, positional state tuples or packed multi-stage expressions
rejected_changes.reason: would lower Agent readability and erase the relationship between generated geometry, graph propagation and rendering

rejected_changes.change: Reduce nodes, edges, pulses, glow layers or title-field calculations
rejected_changes.reason: would change the governing system or visual density

rejected_changes.change: Precompute graph frames or replace the runtime with captured media
rejected_changes.reason: would remove the real seeded motion, topology rebuild, shortest-arrival propagation and inputs

rejected_changes.change: Treat the formal 9,800-character source as the auxiliary mini
rejected_changes.reason: its compression relies on abbreviated, coupled source rather than a deliberately selected readable subset

cross_audit.revision: Aborting only seedrandom.min.js previously caused Math.seedrandom is not a constructor, leaving no API, graph or fallback. The candidate now uses a named FNV-seeded compact PRNG only when that local dependency is absent. Normal dependency-present execution is unchanged and remains pixel-identical to formal.
cross_audit.readability: Readable-compact for the full 720-node generator: configuration, title field, graph reconstruction, shortest-arrival relaxation, propagation, drawing, inputs and lifecycle have semantic stage names. The local N alias is a conventional cardinality bound immediately destructured from nodeCount, not business state; expanding it would add repetition without clarifying the algorithm. CSS keeps one rule per line, and JavaScript stays at or below 114 characters per line.
cross_audit.algorithm_integrity: The candidate still seeds and evolves 720 nodes, rebuilds proximity edges, computes weighted arrival arrays at runtime, advances pulses and renders live Canvas marks. No positions, topology, propagation frames or pixels were precomputed.

independent_evidence.governing_model: 720 live nodes and 3,807 initial proximity edges; real pointer, mouse, touch, Enter/Space and R routes retained
independent_evidence.Canvas_fallback: two independent runs produced the same three-path SVG from the live model and identical screenshot hash 36aef26f961bd5c1ca24c960f80638f86f9b282a7fbb2849cf8edf050578cf95
independent_evidence.dependency_fallback: two seedrandom-failure runs retained a live graph and identical model hash 16e223c03ee8592e140cb748a21a6da3dbe4d6752b8cafccec3642306c7e85ec
independent_evidence.lifecycle: live resize passed; pagehide reduced owned loop and resize subscriptions from 1 to 0, made a cached API inert, and reload restored one canvas
independent_evidence.selfcheck: Original selfcheck covered initial, pointer, injection and reset with no clipped or escaped content, overlap, runtime error or failed request.

cross_audit.symlink_and_http: Baseline pages and candidate assets symlinks resolve to the unchanged formal tree and normal bundled resources serve successfully over HTTP.
cross_audit.remaining_risk: The dependency-fallback PRNG intentionally does not reproduce seedrandom's exact node coordinates; it preserves the same live algorithm, density, title exclusion field and deterministic hierarchy when the normal dependency is unavailable.
